What Prime Intellect sells

  • Lab: A platform for reinforcement learning (models learn by trying tasks and receiving scores) and further model training.
  • Environment Hub: Environments for model training and evaluation.
  • Verifiers: An open-source library for creating environments that train and evaluate language models.
  • Prime-RL: An open-source framework for large-scale reinforcement learning, with training and model evaluation tools.
  • Prime Inference Gateway: Provides one OpenAI-compatible API for accessing models served by third-party providers.
  • Sandboxes: Isolated environments for training and evaluation.
